data.name: Gakuen Club
data.detailed_description:
-------------------------------
・This game's story is identical to the one for the Gakuen Club(学園CLUB～放課後のヒミツ～) smart phone app.
・The entire main story is included. (Puzzle games are not included)
・The game is fully voiced, but MC(heroine) has no voice.
-------------------------------
■ What is Gakuen Club?
Gakuen Club is a school life romance game set in a famous private academy. The main cast includes popular voice actors KENN, Kensho Ono, Kosuke Toriumi, Tsubasa Yonaga, Yuichiro Umehara, and Mark Ishii whose works can be found in many anime shows and games.
The game features unique and distinct characters with their own stories and outstanding voice work.

■ Story
Our heroine is entering her junior year of high school when she finds out she will be suddenly transferring to the famous Kirika Academy located in the city due to her father's new job.
She is quite excited about starting her new school life, but she stumbles upon a secret night club that is being operated after school hours, and gets herself roped into working the kitchen...

As she grows closer to the other waitstaff of the night club, she learns of their past, and finds herself becoming more and more involved in a complicated web of human relationships and romance...

■ Character Introductions
========================
◆Asahi Minakawa Voice Actor: KENN
Heir apparent of the Minakawa Group, the powerful conglomerate that runs Kirika Academy.
Accomplished in both the literary and military arts, he is a true prince. Honest and a little reckless, the older students like him for his unpredictability, while classmates and underclassmen appreciate his natural charisma.

“No means no, okay?”

========================
◆Toma Sakai Voice Actor: Kensho Ono

A well-mannered and elegant young man.
He generally isn't overly enthusiastic, but his frank remarks always stand out.
The female guests love his aloofness and his feminist side he would sometimes show.

"You should stop worrying about me..."

========================
◆ Saku Takizawa Voice Actor: Kosuke Toriumi

A sensitive man of few words who possesses a unique nature.
The females guests praise him for his good listening skills. They say the advice he offers always gives them the last bit of courage they need.

“Are these feelings of mine unwelcome?”

========================
◆Wataru Kagurazaka Voice Actor: Tsubasa Yonaga

Understands his own appeal and uses it to his advantage, playing the cute cuddly puppy character for the female guests.
Cunning and clever, he is generally calculating, but a privileged boy at heart, he will sometimes come off as soft.

"Hey... Do you like me?"

========================
◆Renji Kamiki Voice Actor: Yuichiro Umehara

A talented pianist, he is an avid feminist.
He understands his own charms, making him a natural host.
He possesses a broad perspective, seamlessly assists those in need, and treats everyone equally.

"So let's just keep this a secret between us, okay?"

========================
◆Yuya Yamaoka Voice Actor: Mark Ishii

An open-minded person who effortlessly gains the trust of those around him.
Excellent at reading a room, he can skillfully adjust his energy level and personality.
What's more, the dark glimpses seen behind his expression draws the female guests in, and never lets them go.

"I think you deserve a reward for being such a good learner."

========================

■ We recommend this game to anyone who...
・Likes going out in secret
・Wants to enjoy a fantastic voice cast
・Is a fan of popular illustrator Mero
・Loves school life romance games

-----
Illustration: Mero

reviews.review:
Oh...............................  My..................................  Goodness.

Well...  Can we all say that the artwork looks really cute/good and colorful?  Otherwise...  Sigh.

I normally go easy on VNs that aren't meant for Adults, but uh...  There is only so much one can take.

Like.............  If you don't really think about anything at all.......  This could be...  Almost okay...  Otherwise...

[u]The MC:[/u]  Do I even need to mention that she is completely and utterly freaking useless?  No.  But at least she has eyes!  Her favorite phrases are: "I don't know what to do.  How can I help you?  I still couldn't do anything..."  That's right.  The MC NEVER does anything worthy in this game.  At all.

All the bois are on a far higher level than she will ever be and they always will take care of everything.  Themselves.  I have NO idea why they need her.  Whatsoever.  Whatever.

[u]The Bois:[/u]

-> [u]Wataru:[/u] I started off with this one...  As I thought he was going to be either boring or whiny.  Hah.  I was overly wrong.  He was actually...  Pretty good.  I liked his Route.  I think he did far more than some *OTHER* Routes!!!  So he...  He is the only gets the full pass.

-> [u]Renji:[/u] This is the most useless and unnecessary Route.  It repeated three themes together over and over and over again...  Across 15 Chapters.  Ah but wait, he did hurt his finger...  That was different!!!  OMG!  THIS ROUTE IS POINTLESS!!!!!!!!!  And to make it worse?  Everything could've been resolved if a certain "letter" was given to him earlier.  ARGHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!

-> [u]Saku:[/u] Okay hmm...  I severely don't like possessive/controlling bassies, but his Route has a rather appropriate darkness to it and...  He can have some credit.  Maybe a half-pass.  MC is a dirt rug in his Route, constantly licking his boots everywhere he walks.  Enough said.

-> [u]Yuya:[/u] Well, he isn't as terrible as Renji...  But he has some serious aggression issues.  MC just blows it off and tells him "it's okay".  No "sweetie", that is NOT OKAY.  Also...  in this Route...  There is barely any romance...  Because the guy is a real d*ck...  But when she tries to [spoiler]leave?  He grabs her and goes "OMG!!!  I LOVE YOU!!!!!"[/spoiler]  No.

-> [u]Asahi:[/u]  Another Route that makes me question why is the MC needed anyway.  Uh Yuya for some reason is FAR better and MORE SELF AWARE in this Route and Asahi...  Well...  His Route just blows.  Then it ends with: [spoiler]Him dumping everything on his half-brother Yuya and just proposing to the MC (they didn't even confess to one another, but whatever) then Fs off overseas.[/spoiler] Good stuff.  (Sarcasm).

and finally...

-> [u]Toma:[/u] Or should I say...  How to ruin a tsundere.  He started off promising by being hostile and telling her off, but the MC is so noisy, she annoyed him into "liking her".  Yeah right.  This Route...  Minus the darkness/trauma around the Love Interest...  Sucks too.

To end on a good note: At least this game didn't teach you that it was okay to stalk people.

Yeah.  Let's end with that.

Otherwise...  No.

Unless you really like repetitive plots and an MC that does absolutely nothing.......
